title: Advances in Automatically Rating the Trustworthiness of Text Processing Services

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation systems using unbiased and biased test sentences with gendered pronouns and occupation placeholders (e.g., '<Gender-pronoun> is a <Occupation-Performer>') to test if bias is introduced or compensated for. It also proposes using a causal framework with gender-associated names and pronouns to test sentiment distributions in sentiment analysis models.

Testing sentiment analysis systems within a causal framework by supplying text inputs containing emotion words and proper nouns associated with different racial groups, and performing statistical tests to compute differences in deconfounded sentiment score distributions.
